notes: Design only: no compiled C# mod yet.
Existing equipment assignment V4 kept for all 14 characters, but ghost apparel is only a visual reference.
The original grasping dead greatsword special attack is not automatically copied to Andúril.
King lightning: 20 damage per bolt, 300% armor penetration.
Aragorn must have Andúril equipped to summon and recall ghosts.
V7: Summoned ghosts are combat-only; no needs, work, clothing, inventory or replaceable equipment; only select/draft/move/attack and Aragorn summon/recall.
V7: Need suppression and weapon locking require selective C# logic; native controllable humanlike pawns alone do not guarantee these restrictions.
V8: Royalty is now a mandatory DLC dependency because the king receives the original Eltex staff and attacks in melee with it.
V8: King weapon lock identical to other ghosts; no swapping, dropping or gear loot; full replacement on next summon.

V8: King casts exactly 5 turquoise lightning strikes via player-targeted gizmo; cast center within 15 cells; strikes inside a 6-cell radius around center; 20 damage each, 300% armor penetration, 3 in-game hour cooldown (7500 ticks).
V8: Quest boss king uses same lightning ability under AI targeting; summoned king uses manual targeting.
V8: Royal buff applied as a removable Hediff on all other summoned ghosts on same map, default x2 with x1.5/x2.5/x3 menu alternatives; removes immediately when king dies, disappears or is recalled.
V8: The king itself does not get the speed buff; aura persists independent of equipped staff if king is alive and present.
V8: Specific Royalty Eltex staff ThingDef must be checked from DLC defs before hardcoding, rather than guessing defName.
designStatus: Planning V8; implementation not compiled or playtested

kingLightning.targetingRadiusStatus: confirmed user requirement, this is CAST range from king (not AoE radius)
kingLightning.targetMode: Player chooses a center within 15 cells of king; 5 turquoise strikes hit hostile units within 6-cell radius of chosen center. Repeat hits on same hostile are possible if fewer than 5 targets; no friendly targeting.
kingLightning.kingAlsoHasMeleeWeapon: Royalty Eltex staff, vanilla normal melee attacks
kingLightning.summonedKingCastMode: manual targeted Ability gizmo, standard cooldown applies from cast
kingLightning.bossKingCastMode: AI selects enemy target location automatically
kingLightning.selectionRule: only enemy units; avoid friendly fire; prefer enemies for each bolt, may repeat targets when fewer than five exist
kingLightning.lineOfSightRule: implementation detail to validate against map and ability targeting

ghostImplementation.graphicSource: custom ghost appearance, dark silhouettes with turquoise aura; apparel references only as optional visuals
ghostImplementation.weaponSource: weapon ThingDefs from The Profaned / Divine Order; prevent dropped loot on expiration and death
ghostImplementation.armorMethod: No mandatory Hediff; role-specific native armor stats computed by C# StatPart on custom player-controllable humanlike combat pawns (six classes) and shared global scaling.

globalArmorScale.note: A 10th level 1000% is not exactly 10× the 50% on level 1.

ghostImplementation.compatibilityCaveat: Natural armor may not work as expected with Combat Tweaks Armor Deflection Rework enabled; user likely disables or replaces mod.
ghostImplementation.roleSpecificArmorMethod: Use native ArmorRating_Sharp/Blunt/Heat stat calculation keyed to the ghost PawnKindDef via C# StatPart; no Hediff required for armor.
ghostImplementation.pawnGraphics: Independent original spectral soldier sprites inspired by LOTR film green/turquoise translucent ancient armored dead; ragged cloth, glowing eyes, mist and particle aura; no copied movie art.

playerControl.searchAndDestroy: expected if drafted; verify in game
playerControl.runAndGun: expected for drafted ranged weapon pawns; test thrown Cleansing Concoction separately

ghostImplementation.needs: none: no food, rest, mood, recreation, comfort, etc.; suppress NeedDefs only for project ghost pawns
ghostImplementation.needsImplementation: Selective C# patch on Pawn_NeedsTracker.ShouldHaveNeed for project ghost PawnKindDefs; invoke regeneration/removal of needs on spawn/load; validate other mods in game
ghostImplementation.downedOrDeadGhostBehavior: despawn; no corpse, gear, apparel or loot left behind
ghostImplementation.recreateAfterSummon: Fresh combat pawn with fixed per-slot original weapon Def, natural role-specific armor and 100% combat condition even if previously downed or disarmed
ghostImplementation.gearHandling: Create fixed non-lootable internal original-mod weapon for each ghost at each summon; prevent drop/swap/transfer; destroy with pawn on despawn or death.
ghostImplementation.kingEquipment: Royalty Eltex staff as locked, fixed, non-lootable equipment; re-created at each summon
ghostImplementation.kingOnlyAttacks: Standard melee attacks with the Royalty Eltex staff plus targeted manual 5-strike turquoise lightning ability (boss version controlled by AI)
ghostImplementation.buffEligibility: other summoned project ghosts on same map while summoned king alive/active; Hediff applied only to those; never himself, Aragorn, colonists or Profaned enemies
ghostImplementation.armorStatImplementation: Role-specific native ArmorRating_Sharp/Blunt/Heat calculated via small C# StatPart based on pawn identification and global setting; no armor Hediff.

aragonDesign.introQuest: Unique prisoner rescue guarded by The Profaned

bossVictory.unlockWhen: Tagged quest boss pawn downed or killed while Aragorn is physically on the same active quest map and has Anduril equipped
bossVictory.onFailureIfAragornAbsentOrWithoutSword: Do not unlock; quest stays unresolved or explicitly fails; gameplay test required

kingAura.name: Königlicher Befehl
kingAura.type: passive removable Hediff on other summoned ghosts, sustained by presence of the summoned king
kingAura.duration: present only while king active and alive on same map; remove immediately after king death, downing, departure, recall or expiry
kingAura.targets: all other summoned Aragorn ghost pawns on same map, excluding king, Aragorn, colonists and all non-project units
kingAura.burstShotInterval: weapon-defined burst spacing may need separate code; not promised exact factor for burst-type weapons
kingAura.implementation: Assign/removal of named status Hediff via C# on summoned ghost pawns; a custom StatPart or similar runtime adjustment reads the active Hediff and configured multiplier to apply MoveSpeed ×B and melee/ranged cooldown/aiming delays ÷B. Remove Hediff on king death/recall/despawn or when recipients despawn; reapply on new summon.
